english.title: Cause / permit fail to ventilate, heat and cool housing for conventionally reared meat chickens - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens, to fail to ensure that each house was equipped with

(A)_[ventilation]_
(B)_[ventilation and heating and cooling systems]_

designed, constructed and operated in such a way that the concentration of ammonia did not exceed 20 parts per million and the concentration of carbon dioxide did not exceed 3,000 parts per million, when measured at the level of the chickens' heads; when the outside temperature measured in the shade exceeded 30°C, the inside temperature did not exceed the outside temperature by more than 3°C and when the outside temperature was below 10°C, the average relative humidity measured inside the house during a continuous period of 48 hours did not exceed 70%
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(c) and 9 of, and paragraph 5(c) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (England) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
